summary: Phase-4 re-verification of 3 regression fixes (PDP badges, /account/addresses form testids, CheckoutPage guard ordering) + Phase-4 core-flow sanity. Backend: full suite 63/63 passed (incl. test_phase4_delivery 9/9 — order 400 for non-226013, 200 for 226013). Frontend: FIX1, FIX2 (after I added 4 missing data-testids), FIX3 (all 4 guard permutations) and all sanity checks PASS. Note: /app/test_reports/iteration_5.json did not exist from the previous run, so this report reuses that slot.

issues: Seed imagery mismatch: 'Terracotta Hexagon Floor Tile', 'Slate Grey Stone Look Tile' and 'Mosaic Blue Wave Tile' all render the SAME white Carrara-marble photo, so cards/similar-products look duplicated and images do not match titles.
Seller filter facet shows raw truncated ids ('Seller 1ec6a2', 'Seller e94122') instead of seller business names.
Sort control is a native browser <select> rather than the shadcn Select used elsewhere.

action_items: Replace duplicated seed product images so each tile product has a matching, distinct image (affects Home, Category and PDP Similar Products).
Show seller business_name instead of truncated seller_id in the Category seller facet.
Optional: swap the native sort <select> for the shadcn Select component for visual consistency.
critical_code_review_comments: AddressesPage.jsx AddrForm was shipped WITHOUT addr-name / addr-phone / addr-line1 / addr-line2 data-testids even though the fix note claimed they were added — I added them (in-scope). Please keep AddressesPage.AddrForm and CheckoutPage.AddressForm in sync; they are ~60 lines of duplicated form logic (DRY violation) and should be extracted into one shared <AddressForm/> component so testids/pin-lock rules cannot drift again.

CheckoutPage guard order is now correct (loading/user -> isServiceable -> items.length). Because isServiceable is false when NO pincode is stored, a first-time logged-in user hitting /checkout directly always sees checkout-blocked; the copy is reasonable but the 'Go back & verify pincode' button uses nav(-1) which can dead-end on a fresh tab — consider linking to '/' instead.
AddressesPage.jsx uses window.confirm() for delete instead of an AlertDialog.

rca_of_the_issue: Root cause of the one real gap found: the AddressesPage AddrForm was only partially instrumented — the pincode/city/state/type/default/save controls got testids in the previous fix pass but the name/phone/line1/line2 inputs were missed, so the Add-New form could not be filled by testid. Fixed by adding the 4 missing data-testid attributes (no functional change). All other reported regressions were already resolved; an earlier apparent failure of similar-products was a test-side 20s timeout on the /products/{id}/similar call plus a malformed base URL in my first script, both corrected.
